com.svenruppert.jsentinel:jSentinel-crypto-bc 00.79.40 发布, Optional Phase-1b extension that adds memory-hard and bcrypt-style
    password hashing providers backed by BouncyCastle (Argon2id,
    bcrypt, scrypt) on top of the V00.71 PasswordHashProvider SPI from
    jSentinel-core. Strictly opt-in: applications that do not depend on
    this module never pull in bcprov. Loading the module also does not
    touch the global JCA provider order — every algorithm is invoked
    through the BouncyCastle low-level Bouncy Castle Crypto APIs.

com.svenruppert.jsentinel:jSentinel-credentials-hibp 00.79.40 发布, Optional Phase-5 extension that adds a HaveIBeenPwned-style online
    compromised-password checker on top of the V00.71 SPI from
    jSentinel-core. The checker uses the k-anonymity range API: only
    the first five hex chars of the candidate's SHA-1 digest leave the
    process, never the plaintext password (CWE-359). The implementation
    relies on JDK HttpClient only — no additional runtime dependencies.
    Strictly opt-in; applications that do not depend on this module
    perform no online lookups.
